base_chain.embedding: unchanged from active production retrieval collection

configs.Q0_CURRENT_HYBRID: Original question, Stage 2A frozen Current Hybrid rows.
configs.Q2_ORIGINAL_PLUS_SINGLE_REWRITE: Original query plus single rewrite, fused.
configs.Q3_ORIGINAL_PLUS_DECOMPOSITION: Original query plus 0-3 decomposition queries, fused; max 4 retrieval queries per logical question.

failure_policy.Q1: rewrite failure records a failed retrieval row
failure_policy.Q2_Q3: rewrite/decomposition failure falls back to original query only and is flagged
